description: ICS Ransomware and Cyber-Physical Attack Incident Dataset, 2016–2025 (N=127) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Denis Ashihie, Bassey Ele (University of Calabar). Incident-level dataset of 127 documented ransomware and cyber-physical attacks on US critical infrastructure ICS (water, electrical, transportation sectors), 2016–2025. Reconstructed deterministically from published summary statistics in the associated systematic review manuscript. Contains 27 variables per incident including sector, network architecture, attack vector, breach outcome, defence layers, MTTD, financial impact, and attack surface score. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
